newsitem.title: CHINA: China auto production over 1.2 million in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: China auto production over 1.2 million in Jan-Oct.

text.p: China produced 1.2138 million automobiles in the first 10 months of 1996, up 2.42 percent from the same 1995 period, the overseas edition of the People's Daily said on Monday.
Sales between January and October totalled 1.1746 million units, up 1.32 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
The Ministry of Machine-Building Industry forecast China would manufacture 1.55 million automobiles in 1996, including 350,000 to 400,000 sedans.
Sedan production and sales climbed by 12.45 percent and 3.1 percent, respectively, in October to 35,100 and 34,400 units from the year-ago period, the ministry said.

Production and sales of China's seven biggest auto manufacturers rose 16.43 percent and 14.49 percent, respectively, in the first 10 months to 83,300 and 82,100 units from the same 1995 period, it said.
The ministry estimated that auto production next year would total 1.65 million units.
